notes: All 12 views inspected. Goblet-form brass vase with a flared trumpet mouth, a faceted shoulder, a slim stem and a spread foot. The top view shows a genuinely hollow interior with tarnish gradient down the throat and the underside shows a closed foot ring. Hammered micro-relief and warm tarnish vary convincingly around the body.
limitations: Interior is modelled but shallow relative to the outer height.
No maker's stamp on the base.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
